definition: Log-compressed maximum reconstructed z-band flux stored as log10(1 + peak flux).
physical_interpretation: Band-specific peak brightness is a strong classifier signal, consistent with transient luminosity structure.

definition: Signed-log mean reconstructed r-band flux stored as sign(value) * log10(1 + abs(value)).
formula_or_computation: sign(mean r-band flux) * log10(1 + abs(mean r-band flux))
physical_interpretation: Average r-band brightness encodes scale information beyond a single peak snapshot.

definition: Magnitude-style color proxy computed as -2.5 * log10(g-band peak flux / r-band peak flux), then clipped to [-5, 5].
physical_interpretation: Color near peak captures temperature or spectral-slope differences characteristic of Ia evolution.

definition: Log-compressed maximum reconstructed i-band flux stored as log10(1 + peak flux).
physical_interpretation: i-band peak brightness contributes strongly to separating Ia from non-Ia events.

definition: Magnitude-style color proxy computed as -2.5 * log10(r-band peak flux / i-band peak flux), then clipped to [-5, 5].
physical_interpretation: r-i color acts as a spectral-slope proxy near peak.

definition: Magnitude-style color proxy computed as -2.5 * log10(i-band peak flux / z-band peak flux), then clipped to [-5, 5].
physical_interpretation: i-z color contributes to distinguishing redder or later-phase light-curve behavior.

definition: Signed-log mean reconstructed g-band flux stored as sign(value) * log10(1 + abs(value)).
formula_or_computation: sign(mean g-band flux) * log10(1 + abs(mean g-band flux))
physical_interpretation: Mean g-band brightness adds complementary information to peak-only brightness proxies.

definition: Log-compressed maximum reconstructed r-band flux stored as log10(1 + peak flux).
physical_interpretation: r-band peak brightness remains informative even after compact pruning.

definition: Log-compressed standard deviation of reconstructed z-band flux stored as log10(1 + std).
formula_or_computation: log10(1 + standard deviation of reconstructed z-band flux)
physical_interpretation: Spread in z-band flux captures shape or variability around peak.

definition: Log-compressed reconstructed i-band amplitude stored as log10(1 + max peak-to-trough amplitude).
formula_or_computation: log10(1 + max peak-to-trough reconstructed i-band amplitude)
physical_interpretation: i-band amplitude captures reconstructed peak-to-trough flux contrast as a light-curve-shape proxy.
manuscript_caution: This is a reconstructed i-band peak-to-trough amplitude proxy, not a direct bolometric amplitude.

definition: Log-compressed standard deviation of reconstructed i-band flux stored as log10(1 + std).
formula_or_computation: log10(1 + standard deviation of reconstructed i-band flux)
physical_interpretation: i-band variability helps capture light-curve shape, not just scale.

definition: Maximum normalized observation time minus minimum normalized observation time.
formula_or_computation: max(normalized observation time) - min(normalized observation time)
physical_interpretation: Observed temporal coverage contributes because different classes occupy different effective time windows.
manuscript_caution: This is observational time coverage, not a measured rise time or decline time.

definition: Normalized time at which reconstructed z-band flux reaches its maximum.
formula_or_computation: normalized time coordinate at maximum reconstructed z-band flux
physical_interpretation: Inter-band timing helps capture peak-lag structure in the transient.

definition: Normalized time at which reconstructed i-band flux reaches its maximum.
formula_or_computation: normalized time coordinate at maximum reconstructed i-band flux
physical_interpretation: Peak timing in i band contributes to the time-evolution signature of Ia light curves.

definition: Normalized time at which reconstructed r-band flux reaches its maximum.
formula_or_computation: normalized time coordinate at maximum reconstructed r-band flux
physical_interpretation: Peak timing in r band reflects band-lag physics and phase structure.

definition: Log-compressed standard deviation of reconstructed r-band flux stored as log10(1 + std).
formula_or_computation: log10(1 + standard deviation of reconstructed r-band flux)
physical_interpretation: r-band spread adds another light-curve-shape cue after pruning redundant amplitudes.
